translation.name: Raraŋ Aetaniacna Kam Wembaŋ Laŋ
translation.englishName: New Testament in Mborena Kam language

content: Iesusa wain warɨŋna aiŋa mona ramtaɨrta kam roora keatna

Karica Iesusa gaind mac mbopatna, “Aku kam roor ian makecek. Tamuŋna auŋna bubuoca ma wain warɨŋapna ramoot ian toc. Na ŋaŋarmuŋ ŋgoinna, an ramootta, ma taŋga ndona wain warɨŋna aiŋa mona ramtaɨrta korena taŋrina.
Ainda moca ma minap kam leaca, mina ra kabena aiŋa mo te, ma minmo ruar kabena kitukndukna mɨn mbuŋa oiknande. Ri, ma mimo mbagɨrica mina mana wain warɨŋna aiŋa mona mataŋgat.
Karica rana ŋgaŋganŋgɨa 9na mɨn toca tɨkri, ma mac taŋga mina punirena taupca watri, ramtaɨr ndeida anna wɨtɨkca, wanaiŋa eacrenan.
Ri, ma minmo gaindopatna, ‘Ne toco, taŋca aukna wain warɨŋna aiŋa mo te, aku nena aiŋa morena mɨnna kitukndukna mɨnna oiknande.’
Ainda moca mina taŋri, na rana ŋgaŋganŋgɨa parniŋapa mbut mbuniŋna mɨnna tɨkri, ma an punirena taup mac taŋri, na rana ŋgaŋganŋgɨa mbonkacna mɨnna tɨkri, ma an tɨp kirar kabea mac mamori.
“Na ra uriraca mbe tambatta tɨkri, ma taŋga mina punirena taupca watri, ramtaɨr ndeida wɨtɨkca wanaiŋ eacrenan, ri, ma mimo madigiat, ‘Tida moca gan ra rocotta ne ganna wɨtɨkca aiŋa mo ŋgocor?’
Ri, mina mana kamma rutica, aindopatna, ‘Ramoot ianna aimo aŋgɨca mana aiŋa mo ŋgocor.’ Na ma minmo aindoprina, ‘Ne toca taŋca aukna wainna warɨŋna aiŋa mo.’

“Na wigwac ŋgoinna, an wain warɨŋna aetta, ma ndona aiŋa raupŋirena ramoot paŋanmo aindopatna, ‘An aiŋa morina ramtaɨrmo aca kɨpca, minmo mina kituknduk neaŋ. Na u mimo ainda neaŋ, an iŋa kɨpca aiŋa morinan ndiŋa taŋca an outmbainanmo kabe, kabea neaŋ.’
Ri, an wigwac ŋgoinna kɨpca aiŋa morina ramtaɨra, mina kɨpca ndorita ruar kabe, kabea maaŋgɨat.
Ri, an ŋaŋarmuŋa aiŋa outmbai nakɨpca moatnanna, mina ndorimo tamuŋmbai naaŋgɨ ndamŋiatnanna wanaiŋ, mitoca ruar kabe, kabe maaŋgɨat.
Na mina an aŋgɨatke, mina an wain warɨŋna aetmo kekelamun kerina.

Mina aindopatna, ‘Gan ramtaɨra mina wigwacna aiŋ niŋgikca morinan, na aia aiŋ aniac ŋgoinna morinan, ŋaŋarmuŋa tɨkca kɨpca gan mɨn, na ra aimo rotacrinan, na u mina neaŋgapekna opoik kirar kabea u aimo an neaŋrinan.’
“Karica an warɨŋna aetta an kamma waraca, ma mina ianmo aindopatna, ‘Ramoot, aku umo tɨp ŋgoreac ianna mba mori, na aŋga outta gan ra kabena aiŋna opoikna kamma leacrina.
Na u ndona kituknduk aŋgɨca taŋ, aku ndona toŋtoŋ mbuŋa an iŋa kɨpca aiŋa morina ramootmo, an u aŋgɨrina kitukndukna kirara neaŋnandet.
Na anna aukna reac, aku ndona toŋtoŋa raŋgaica kitukndukmo titoca biŋai te, anna aukna reac niŋgik? Aintik aku gan ramtaɨrmo tɨp laŋa mona, kaina moca u aukmo kɨracre?’”
Ri, Iesusa aindopatna, “Aintik an iŋmbaina eacrina ramtaɨr, mina outta eacnande. Na outta eacrenan, mina iŋmbaia eacnandet.”
Iesusa ndo menaca mac nda ŋgepna kam mac mbopatna
Iesusa ndona iŋa raŋgairena ramtaɨr parniŋapa mbut mbuniŋna ramtaɨr tiŋgik aŋgɨca, mina Ierusalemma taŋna taup ndiŋa taŋri, ma mimo gaindopatna,

“Ne warac, mandeaca aia Ierusalem mataŋgek, na mina Ramootna Nuocmo taup ndamtaɨr paŋaindapa tɨpemb wandik tamŋirena ramtaɨrta para tɨknandet. Te, mina mamo ritri waparaca mo te, mamo mo menacna kam leacnande.
Na mina mamo Iudana meikramtaɨr wanaiŋna para tɨk te, mina mamo peperena kam ndopnandet, na mamo pinandet, na mamo ik nakeracnande. Na rai mbonkac mbuŋa, ma mac nda ŋgepnandet.”
Iemisapa Ionna aemna digdigi
Karica anna iŋmbaia Sebedina nuocniŋna aemma, mana nuocniŋap kɨpca Iesusna outmo tutupniŋ rɨmbɨtca ma mamo digdigi ianna digina.

Ri, Iesusa mamo, ainda digiatna, “U kaica toŋgorina?” Na ma rutica aindopatna, “U aukap kam leaca, una bubuocna kaŋgaukmo, aukna nuocniŋmo aŋgɨca, ianmo una par umbaia tɨkca mbirac te, ianmo una par aeŋmbaia tɨkca mbiracna.”
Ainda moca ma maniŋna kammo rutica aindopatna, “Oŋgo an digdigia digirenanna, oŋgo mba lamŋirenan? Na oŋgo an gɨgɨrara auk ndambuŋnan aŋgɨna mɨn ki?” Ri, maniŋa rutica aindopatna, “Aŋga mɨn.”

Na ma maniŋmo aindoprina, “Gidik, oŋgo auk aŋgɨekna gɨrgɨra oŋgo aŋgɨna mɨn, na umo aukna umbai, co, aukna aeŋmbaina para mbiracnanna, aku mba mbopitndai. An mbibiracna reikca anna aukna Aetta larapacrina meikramtaɨrtan.”
Ainda moca an mana iŋa raŋgairena parniŋna mɨnna ramtaɨra, anna waraca mina maniŋmo nikkataririnan.

Aintik ma minmo aca kɨpca ma minmo aindoprina, “Ne lamŋirena Iudana meikramtaɨr wanaiŋnanta ramtaɨr paŋainda, mina ndorita meikramtaɨrmo makukara neaŋrenanapa, mina minmo mba matau raupŋirenan. Na mina ramtaɨr paŋaind anik toco, minmo gagra mbopca mina, mina raŋgaica mina kambca waracna.
Ainda moca an tɨp kirara nenap kai eac teac, na nena ianna ma ndomo ramoot paŋan aniac ndeacnan, ma nemo mbaiŋna ramoot ndaru.
Na ramootta nenmo outmbaica eaceknanna, ma nenmo mbaiŋna ramootna kirar toc ndeac.

An kirar kabe, Ramootna Nuoca kɨprinanna, meikramtaɨra mana aiŋa moca manmo otacnanna wanaiŋ. Ma kɨprinanna, ma minmo otacna aiŋa mona kɨprina, te, ma ndona eteacna wat neaŋca meikramtaɨr wɨt mac nda aŋgɨna.”
Lamnɨac ŋgoreacna ramootniŋmo Iesusa moa laŋa moatna
Karica Iesusapa mana iŋa raŋgairena ramtaɨra Ieriko auŋ tɨkcarica, taŋri, meikramtaɨr wɨt aniaca mana raŋgairina.
Na lamnɨac ŋgoreacna ramootniŋa taupna roumbca mbiraca eacrena. Na maniŋa waracrinanna Iesusa kɨprena, aintik maniŋa aca mambopat, “Dewitna ŋgamaɨr, aŋna kadmaica aŋmo otac!”

Ri, meikramtaɨra maniŋa aca mboprina kamma waraca, mina maniŋmo tagagarica aindopatna, “Oŋgo watitica eac.” Na maniŋa kocnaia kam aniaca keca aindoprina, “Kacoot, u Dewitna ŋgamaɨr, u aŋmo kadmaica otac.”
Aindopatke, ma wɨtɨkca maniŋmo aca digica. Aindopatna, “Oŋgo toŋgorinanna aku oŋmo tida moit?”
Karica maniŋa mana kammo rutica, aindopatna, “Kacoot, aŋga toŋgorinanna u aŋna lamnɨacniŋmo moa laŋa moca aŋga watna.”
Ri, ma maniŋna kadmaica, ma ndona parmo, maniŋna lamnɨacniŋa tɨkca, maniŋna lamnɨacniŋa anduna laŋa moca, maniŋa watri, maniŋa mana iŋa raŋgaica mataŋgat.
